I went down a rabbit-hole this week thinking about what the most important or seminal songs are when it comes to "grunge" and specifically what I think people now call "yarling," e.g. the growly grunge vocal "yeahhhhhhhhhh" voice (e.g. the classic Eddie Vedder "even floo-oowww") - 
 My memory was the whole genre exploded and crested in 1991, but looking back it was interesting to realize that Man in the Box came out a full year before everything else. Does this mean AIC deserves more credit? 
 Here's my list of seminal yarling moments by release date...
 Alice in Chains - Man in the Box - Release Date August 21, 1990
 Temple of the Dog - Hunger Strike / Say Hello 2 Heaven - Release date April 16, 1991
 Pearl Jam - Ten (all of it, pretty much) - Release Date August 27, 1991
 Nirvana - Smell
